items.raw_excerpt: Há aldeias pequenas que surpreendem pelo que têm para oferecer. É o caso de Casal de São Simão, uma Aldeia…

items.raw_excerpt: For language learners, it's a common experience to have your grammar or pronunciation corrected while speaking to a French person. It is a - mostly - well-meaning habit, but as Emma Pearson explains, it can also take some getting used to.
items.summary_en: Many language learners feel nervous when a French person corrects their grammar or pronunciation. It can be hard to accept at first, but this well-meaning habit actually helps you improve. Getting used to corrections is part of learning a new language.
items.summary_ko: 프랑스어를 배우는 사람들이 프랑스인에게 문법이나 발음을 지적받는 경험은 매우 흔합니다. 처음에는 익숙하지 않지만, 이러한 도움은 실제로 언어 실력 향상에 큰 도움이 됩니다. 언어를 배우는 과정에서 지적을 받아들이는 것은 자연스러운 과정입니다.
items.title_en: Being corrected by French people helps you learn faster

items.raw_excerpt: In late 2025, authorities introduced national ID cards for foreign residents in Norway, but the service was initially limited to EU/EEA/EFTA nationals. Now, the scheme is expanding to cover all third-country residents. We explain how to get yours.
items.summary_en: Norway now lets all foreign residents apply for national ID cards. Earlier only EU and EEA citizens could get them. The new rules began in 2025 and now cover every third-country resident.
items.summary_ko: 노르웨이가 모든 외국인 주민에게 주민등록증 발급을 허용했다. 앞서 EU 및 EEA 국민에게만 적용되던 제도가 확대됐다. 2025년 말부터 시행된 새 규정은 제3국 출신 모든 주민에게 적용된다.
items.title_en: Norway Opens ID Cards to All Foreign Residents

items.raw_excerpt: In March 2026, Swiss voters approved a move to allow married couples to declare their income and assets separately instead of being taxed jointly. However, it will take six years for the new law to be introduced.

items.raw_excerpt: Some expecting parents in Ontario are struggling to schedule routine ultrasound appointments due to growing waitlists and a shortage of sonographers. There is a 20 per cent sonographer vacancy rate in the province, according to Sonography Canada.
items.summary_en: Some expecting parents in Ontario struggle to schedule routine ultrasound appointments due to growing waitlists. There is a 20 per cent sonographer vacancy rate in the province. Some mothers must travel hours for appointments that should be available locally.

items.raw_excerpt: In March 2026 Swiss voters approved a move to allow married couples to declare their income and assets separately instead of being taxed jointly, as has been the case until now. So how will it affect you?
items.summary_en: Swiss voters approved a new law that lets married couples choose to file their taxes separately instead of jointly. The change, passed in March 2026, means each spouse reports their own income and assets. It is expected to benefit couples where one partner earns significantly more than the other.
items.summary_ko: 스위스 유권자들이 부부가 공동이 아닌 개별적으로 세금을 신고할 수 있는 새 법안을 승인했다. 2026년 3월 통과된 이 변경으로 각 배우자는 자신의 소득과 자산을 따로 신고하게 된다. 한쪽 배우자가 다른 쪽보다 소득이 현저히 높은 부부에게 혜택이 될 것으로 예상된다.
items.title_en: Switzerland lets married couples file taxes individually
items.title_ko: 스위스, 부부 개별 세금 신고 허용
items.title_original: How will Switzerland's new individual tax law affect you?

items.raw_excerpt: Karnataka government to continue providing pensions under Social Security Pension scheme to those with an annual income between ₹32,000 and ₹1.20 lakh.
items.summary_en: The Karnataka government is raising the pension income ceiling to 1.20 lakh rupees. This change will help over 2 million people in the state keep their benefits. The scheme is for people earning between 32,000 and 1.20 lakh rupees a year.
